devices_without_area.title: {count} devices have no area
devices_without_area.description:
These devices belong to no area, so neither do any of their entities — an entity inherits its area from its device. Automations and voice assistants that reason by room cannot see them.

{devices}

Open a device and set its area; every one of its entities follows. For a long list, the [device dashboard](/config/devices/dashboard) lets you sort and assign several at once.

Devices Home Assistant marks as a service — a cloud account, a subscription, a bridge — are never listed here: they are not anywhere, and that is correct.
